reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-11-01 captured Sky book (Block Analitica groups feed, eight-group census, 2026-11-01T21:42:23Z) reports $12,263,606,469.42 total collateral and $10,255,119,262.51 total group debt. At Ethereum block 26322700 (2026-11-01T21:46:35Z) LitePSM gem() and pocket() return canonical USDC and the verified pocket, which holds $3,627,959,769.713103 USDC. Stablecoins module collateral is $3,628,753,635.570323, so the measurement sits $793,865.857219 below it, no excess cap applies, and the exact residual is published as a 0.01% classification row. Composition shares now use the gross-asset book as the denominator: Spark 31.78%, USDC 29.58%, Grove 13.83%, Core 11.35%, Staking Engine 9.53%, Obex 3.31%, Legacy RWA 0.57%, Osero 0.04% and residual 0.01%, with largest-remainder two-decimal rounding summing to 100.00. This replaces the 2026-10-27 group-debt shares, which understated the over-collateralised Core and Staking Engine modules (3.66% and 1.51%) relative to the published collateral book. Both DAI and USDS share this book. Positive unexplained remainders and failed reconciliations retain the existing very-low PSM-pool risk, without an inferred constituent identity. Allocators remain classified at their deployed-strategy failure domain.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: 2026-11-01 captured group-collateral shares (largest-remainder two-decimal rounding sums to 100.00); canonical gem() and measured LitePSM USDC pocket balance at Ethereum block 26322700 reconciled against stablecoins module collateral
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Unexplained positive PSM remainders stay unlinked; excess above 0.25 percentage points fails the split closed. Allocator groups have no invented tracked-token look-through weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Grove is a Sky Agent allocation into institutional-credit strategies, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Spark is an allocator and lending-protocol position with multiple deployment counterparties, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Obex is an Agent allocation across supported institutional stablecoin projects rather than one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Core bucket is a multi-collateral crypto-vault pool, not one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Staking Engine bucket is collateralized by SKY positions in LockStake Engine vaults, not by another tracked stablecoin.
The legacy RWA bucket represents external legal structures and obligors rather than a direct tracked-stablecoin dependency.
Osero is a Sky allocator position with mutable deployed strategies rather than one direct tracked-stablecoin reserve asset.
